meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 每次成功的编辑操作(apply_patch、write、edit 等)之后会自动检查注释,发现警告就向 Codex 发出阻断式反馈,要求先修改或解释被标记的注释再继续。
howto.when: 在成功的 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类调用触发 PostToolUse 钩子后介入;非编辑类工具不触发。

say.text: comment-checker 报了注释警告,帮我改掉
say.note: Codex 会先处理被标记的注释

say.text: 解释一下刚才被标记的那条注释
say.note: Codex 给出说明而不直接改

say.text: 把被标记的注释删掉再继续
say.note: 删掉该注释后继续原任务

howto.what_en: After each successful edit (apply_patch, write, edit, etc.) it checks comments automatically; when a warning appears Codex gets blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment first.
howto.when_en: Triggers after the PostToolUse hook fires for successful apply_patch, write, edit and similar edit calls; non-edit tools are ignored.

say_en.text: comment-checker flagged a comment, please fix it
say_en.note: Codex handles the flagged comment first

say_en.text: Explain the comment that was just flagged
Delete the flagged comment and continue
say_en.note: Removes it, then resumes the task
